-- Totals: 24 tables, 12 partitioned, 19 with INCREMENTAL TRUE, 0 stale, 0 without statistics, 0 locked, 3 with locked partitions, 0 with pending statistics
-- Blocks: 22906 in the tables, an estimated 4506 read by one plain GATHER_TABLE_STATS per table (indexes not counted)

-- Why the ranking is what it is (estimated blocks, simplified from the advisor's rules; the header of survey.sql has the formula):
--   plain table                 read once, however stale it is: a plain GATHER_TABLE_STATS ignores staleness
--   partitioned, not incremental every partition, then the whole table once more: two passes (lab T0, L1); one pass with GRANULARITY PARTITION
--   incremental, synopses all   only the new or changed partitions; the global statistics come from the synopses
--   incremental, none or stale  every unlocked partition once to build the synopses; stale with some partitions lacking one: those
--   locked partition            with DML (no USE_LOCKED_STATS) or no synopsis: the global statistics need a full scan on every gather (lab C1, V2)
--   table statistics locked     0: the gather raises error 20005 (statistics locked) and the automatic job skips the table
--   IDX is the index count: CASCADE reads each index in full on top of EST.READ (lab F2, F3)
--   LAST GATHER looks at table-level tasks only; BY auto = the automatic job, call = DBMS_STATS called by a session or a job of yours
